name: Dumbbell Wrist Ulnar Deviation

rehabilitation.clinical_protocol: AAOS Wrist and Forearm Conditioning Program

steps: Sit tall with your forearm resting securely on a table or your thigh, hand extending over the edge.
Hold a light dumbbell with your thumb pointing straight up in a neutral position.
Keeping your forearm anchored, tilt your wrist downward toward the floor (in the direction of your pinky finger).
Hold for 1 second in controlled ulnar deviation.
Slowly raise your wrist back up to the neutral starting position.
coaching_cues: Do not allow your elbow to lift off the table.
Move smoothly without snapping or bouncing at the end range.
Control both the downward tilt and the return upward.

sources.attribution: AAOS Wrist and Forearm Conditioning Program
